# Errors

## Thrown errors

Anything thrown in middleware, a handler or a template becomes a `500`.

- **Dev mode or `debug: true`:** an HTML error page with the message, the file and line (template lines map to the `.ets` or `.md` source), and the stack trimmed to `pb_pages`-relative paths.
- **Otherwise:** a plain "Something went wrong" page.

The full error always goes to the app's log.

## `ctx.httpError(status, message)`

Throw `ctx.httpError()` to answer with a specific status:

```ts
// pb_pages/products/[id].ts
module.exports = {
  load(ctx) {
    let product
    try {
      product = ctx.app.findFirstRecordByData('products', 'slug', ctx.params.id)
    } catch (e) {
      throw ctx.httpError(404, 'No such product') // findFirstRecordByData throws when nothing matches
    }
    ctx.data.product = product
  },
}
```

- In a page, it sends that status with a plain page showing `message`.
- In an [endpoint](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/pages/api-routes), it sends JSON (unless the request's `Accept` puts `text/html` first): `{ "status": 404, "message": "No such product" }`.

## A custom error page

Create `pb_pages/+error.ets`. It renders for every `ctx.httpError` and for every `500` outside dev mode, inside the root layout, with `ctx.error = { status, message }`:

```ets
<!-- pb_pages/+error.ets -->
<% slot('title', () => { %>Error <%= ctx.error.status %><% }) %>
<h1><%= ctx.error.status %></h1>
<p><%= ctx.error.message %></p>
```

`+error` and `+404` live only at the top of `pb_pages`. Either may be `.ets` or `.tsx`.

## A custom 404 page

Create `pb_pages/+404.ets`. It renders inside the root layout, with status `404`, for a `GET` or `HEAD` that nothing answers: no page, no file in `pb_public` and no PocketBase route. It never renders for `/api/` or `/_/`. The root `+middleware.ts` runs first, and page code can still change the status.

```ets
<!-- pb_pages/+404.ets -->
<% slot('title', () => { %>Not found<% }) %>
<h1>Not found</h1>
<p>Nothing lives at <%= ctx.req.url.pathname %>.</p>
```
